task_description: create the gui wrapper with drag and drop feature

patterns.conversion_pattern: Use convert_png_to_ico() function from ico_converter.py for all conversions
patterns.error_handling_pattern: Try/except blocks with user-friendly messages, return True/False for success
patterns.file_handling_pattern: Use pathlib.Path for cross-platform file operations
patterns.type_hints_pattern: All functions use type annotations (input_path: Path, output_path: Path, etc.)
patterns.gui_framework: Tkinter with tkinterdnd2 for drag-and-drop (minimal dependencies, built-in)

existing_implementations.description: ico_converter.py contains fully functional CLI tool with conversion logic that can be imported and reused

relevant_functions.convert_png_to_ico: Core conversion function - accepts Path objects, returns bool, handles RGBA conversion
relevant_functions.DEFAULT_SIZES: List of (width, height) tuples for standard icon sizes
relevant_functions.collect_files: File collection pattern - can be adapted for GUI drag-drop

key_insights: Conversion logic is already tested and working
Path objects used throughout - good for GUI integration
Size configuration via simple list of tuples
